response.rationale: These are two different concepts. A is a report that RinkService.getReport builds from a query with a date range or week ("getReport(q: { from?: unknown; to?: unknown; weekStart?: unknown }): Report", src/business/rinkService.ts, node 21c65604dec116b1). It's a summary computed over a time period. B is the Session entity itself, kept in a map by InMemorySessionRepository ("private readonly sessions = new Map<string, Session>();", src/persistence/sessionRepository.ts, node cbb2626cc4574661). A report may summarise sessions, but it is a separate thing derived from them, not the same concept under another name. Sharing the word "session" doesn't make them the same. One thing I can't settle from what's shown: whether B's Session is a rink skating session or a login session. Either way, it isn't the report.
